maddeler.e:
نتعاصر (form VI)
# نَتَعَاصَرُ (nataʕāṣaru) /na.ta.ʕaː.sˤa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاصَرَ (taʕāṣara)
# نَتَعَاصَرَ (nataʕāṣara) /na.ta.ʕaː.sˤa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاصَرَ (taʕāṣara)
# نَتَعَاصَرْ (nataʕāṣar) /na.ta.ʕaː.sˤar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَاصَرَ (taʕāṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
